title: Now you can watch Instagram Reels on your Apple TV
summary: Instagram is continuing its expansion into living rooms with Instagram for TV, for Apple TV. The company first started testing a version of the platform focused on Reels, live streams, and other video content, blown up for a bigger screen in December of last year. llm_summary: Instagram is rolling out a dedicated app for Apple TV that lets users watch Reels, live streams and other video content on the big screen. After a limited test of a “TV‑focused” version last December, the service now ships with new features—such as a full‑screen interface and remote navigation—making it easier to browse Instagram’s video feed from the living‑room.
